subject: alt-ft
title: ALT.FT.------WO.EXP.PRI.
description: Chart 2 of 2 on book p. 124 (ALT(FT)II-18). ALT-FT (alternative functionalism) is the subject; WO-EXP-PRI (world expansion principle) is the partner. From the subject: PROJ-DY (projectional dynamics), INFO-TRNS (information transference) and POL-DYM (political dynamics). From PROJ-DY: RE-ST (restructuralism). From INFO-TRNS: C-INFO (composite information). From POL-DYM: MT-INFO (multi-information). From C-INFO: ALT-D (alternative definitions). From MT-INFO: ACT (activism). From ACT: P-FC (particular focus).
